correctness.rationale: Chen--Lee Lemma 2.1 gives \((a+b+2)^3=64ab\). With \(s=a+b\), AM--GM gives \((s+2)^3\le16s^2\). The difference \((s+2)^3-16s^2\) is positive and increasing for \(s\ge9\), so \(2\le s\le8\). Integrality of \(ab=(s+2)^3/64\) then forces \(4\mid s+2\); in the interval \(4\le s+2\le10\), this leaves only \(s=2,6\), giving products \(1,8\) and hence exactly \((1,1)\) and \((2,4)\). Both surviving spaces are known smoothable.

value.rationale: The two-unit family \(\mathbf P(1,1,a,b)\) is the simplest infinite weighted-projective threefold slice beyond ordinary projective space and occurs naturally in the degeneration program. The result closes that entire slice exactly, with no bounded computation and no local singularity hypotheses, sharpening the initiating paper's broader conditional methods. It also converts the general cubic volume obstruction into a complete if-and-only-if classification, rather than a routine numerical example.
